paper_id: Improving Low Resource Named Entity Recognition using Cross-lingual Knowledge Transfer
title: Improving Low Resource Named Entity Recognition using Cross-lingual Knowledge Transfer
motivation: 神经网络NER模型在低资源语言上因缺乏标注数据导致性能下降
problem_framing: 通过跨语言知识迁移丰富低资源语言词语的语义表示
key_insight: 不同语言包含互补的实体线索可通过双语词典转移；实体类型分布在语言间保持不变
method_signature: LSTM-CRF + 双语词典编码 + 词典扩展 + 实体类型分布特征
evaluation_criteria: F-score on CoNLL Dutch/Spanish and OntoNotes Chinese
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: CLNER性能较低因其使用基于语言资源的间接特征和跨语言实体映射；这些方法存在错误传播问题
evidence_for_taste: sequence feature is more important for modeling lexicon structure
cross-language representation has better ability to model non-covered entities
entity type distribution can be regarded as a language-independent knowledge
bilingual lexicons are one of the most basic language resources
thinking_moves: 用双语词典在语义层面嫁接高低资源语言
线性投影解决词典覆盖不到的词(OOV问题)
实体类型分布作为语言无关特征跨语言迁移
强调序列特征优于注意力机制用于词典结构建模
